book.name: METIU
book.title: Yeisu Wasane Dodohobine Metiu wana Luluweli

content: Yeisu hana Hao Sesevevekine I Youmate
Yan ho-wone (6) i mwao, bwen Yeisu i sehapeid Pita, Jems ge havane Jon, sidiye ege he-bwaine si la si tihe sai he bobokun mimisaiine.
Habe hana hao sesevevekine i youmate he matadiye. Mangingine i tale sohode parae ge hana kaliko i kanekane ge i piklame suwok.
Bwen topadavae si he-tuwon si paidi Moses ge Ilaija si youmate, ge bwaidiye Yeisu si lihulihu.
Habe Pita i liwo Yeisu heine i nga, “Guyau, i dohob te hide mwage he ya. Hebe nuwam, bwen lun ho-tuwon a ginawiid, hotiya huwo, hotiya Moses, ge hotiya Ilaija.”

Saugeine Pita mwage i lihulihu, habe yaluyalu kanekaneine i yabomid, bwen halhalinge hotiya i hudi he yaluyalu i nga, “Ga yetei natu nunuwaneine suwok; a yariyae suwok iye kaiwane. Halingane gen hu longe!”
Sauge topadavae si longe halhalinge ya, bwen si matok suwok ge si tiyepwahem he kelekele.
Yeisu i luwom heidiye, i bwangeid ge i nga, “Hu suwoyuk. Tab matok.”
Saugeine matadiye si lisin, taine tolomo hotiya si depaidi, Yeisu i totiya ege.
Sauge si sesedom he bobokun, bwen Yeisu i liwo heidiye i nga, “Tab hu egiyau tolomo hotiya wana wase heto sahe gane hu paidi kaiwane, hana had Tolomo Natune i suwoyukim he mate.”
Bwen topadavae si tayak Yeisu si nga, “Sahe kaiwane Logugui hana topapalapu si nga tage Ilaija bwele i eluwom dei, muyai habe Mesaiya i luwom?”
Yeisu i golase halingadiye i nga, “Tolosuwok Ilaija bwele i eluwom dei, iloke bigi hohoyowate i bagavetahe.
Age a liwo heimiu, Ilaija hobak i luwom mwao, agegene bobode taine si delapu, iloke bigi hebwaden si nuwotuyan si ginawi ege heine. Sohode hedi, Tolomo Natune bwele habe si patilao.”
Habeto topadavae si lapu age Jon Tobaptais lihuine te i nga, “Ilaija hobak i luwom mwao.”
Yeisu I Pamolu Tokikiwosi Hotiya
Sauge si sehavile si la boda heidiye, habe tolomo hotiya i luwom Yeisu heine, i lipwakoko he hana hao
ge i nga, “Guyau, gen u hatatilao-yan natu. I kikiwosi ge i nuwale suwok. Sauge i hoyowate i sopiyele he hiwo o hebe he bwai.
A ho luwom lam topadavae heidiye, agegene taine bosowaidiye si depamolu.”

Habe Yeisu i nga, “Aa humiu, taine lemi goru i degan ge nuwotu bwabwaligane hu pi vevekan! Hobak sauge i mwalao te he-bwalu humiu ta miyemiye he ya! Pe-piye a palahasik kaiwamiu? Sevai yake hu ho luwom heyau.”
Yeisu i liwo yayaluwo bikbikine heine bwen i setagi, ge petaege sevai yake i molu.
Habeto topadavae sidiye ege si luwom Yeisu heine ge si tayak si nga, “Sahe kaiwane hamai taine bosowaimai ha deliwo ge yayaluwo bikbikine i desetagi?”

I golase halingadiye i nga, “Kaiwane taine lemi goru i dekai. Tolosuwok a liwo heimiu, hebe lemi goru i gan, bwagane i tankai sohode hayao pwatumine, bosowaimiu hu liwo bobokun ya heine hu nga, ‘U miyok habam, u la he yake,’ bwen i ginawi sohode. Hebe lemi goru i gan, taine bigi hotiya bwele i depuyowo tage taine bosowaimiu hu deginawi.
Age yayaluwo bikbikine sohode ti yake taine bosowaine ta deliwo i desetagi, iyege te hebe ta hawanun ge ta palahasik buwota hawanun yake kaiwane.”
Yeisu I Lihulihu hedi wana Mate kaiwane
Saugeine topadavae si luwom si mipase Galili, habe i liwo heidiye i nga, “Hawesine ege bwen Tolomo Natune si taeman bobode he nimadiye,
iloke si lopamate ge he yan ho-tuwonine bwele i suwoyuk hedi.” Bwen topadavae nuwadiye i ngak suwok.
Guwole Gagabubine hana Takis hana Pampamaise Lihuine

Saugeine Yeisu he-bwaine wana topadavae si luwom Kapeniyam, Guwole Gagabubine hana takis hana tohowo si luwom si tayak Pita si nga, “Age lemi topapalapu taine i edepamaise Guwole Gagabubine hana takis?”

Pita i golase halingadiye i nga, “Taine! I epampamaise ege.” Habe Pita i la i setuk he guwole. Habe taine i delihuyan lihu hotiya, bwen Yeisu i liwo dei heine i nga, “Saimon, mwatan lam nuwotu? Panayawi hana kin-yan si howo takis segawai heidiye—he-nanatudiye heidiye o hebe mwage bobode papaine heidiye?”

Pita i golase halingane i nga, “Mwage bobode papaine heidiye.” Bwen Yeisu i nga, “Iyete taine bosowaine kin he-nanatune si depamaise takis. Sohode hedi, akum nau tab a epamaise takis Tamau wana guwole kaiwane.

Agegene tab Guwole Gagabubine hana takis hana tohowo ta epahugeid. U lok u la he soge bwen lam yao u bili donge. Yalogi gane u kos deiyan u howo, u pisae gamwane, iloke u paidi mwani wana kaikai i bosowaine wada takis. U howo, u la u pamaise huwo ge nau wada takis.”

footnotes.text: Buk hana toleli papanek, hebwaden veto dedei, topadine si leli ves 21 hana lihu, topadine taine si deleli.
